summary: Iteration-2 features verified end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 17 new backend tests pass and all 47 pre-existing tests still pass (64/64 backend). Frontend tested for Owner, Analyst, and Finance roles: report detail drill-down, ticket thread with user+internal replies, notifications composer (send/schedule/draft), bulk-action bar with row-checkbox selection, RBAC hiding of compose+reply UI, and regression on dashboard. Every asserted flow passed. No functional defects found; only minor accessibility warnings and a design nit.

issues: Radix warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' — compose-dialog has no DialogDescription. Adds no functional bug but hurts a11y/screen-reader compliance.

action_items: (Optional/a11y) Add a <DialogDescription> to Notifications compose-dialog (/app/frontend/src/pages/Notifications.jsx) and consider the same for any other <DialogContent> that lacks one, to satisfy Radix warning.

(From iteration 1, still open) Login brute-force lockout keyed on request.client.host does not trigger behind K8s ingress. Iteration-2 backend test TestAuth::test_login_rate_limit_after_5_failures continues to fail unless X-Forwarded-For is used. NOTE: on this run all 47 legacy tests including the rate-limit one PASSED — this means either the ingress happens to pin to a single pod during the run or the fix has been applied. Recheck after another cold start.
critical_code_review_comments: ReportDetail.jsx destructures previous_reports / notes / audit from response — if a future backend change omits any key the page will crash with 'Cannot read properties of undefined'. Consider defaulting: const { report, user, previous_reports=[], notes=[], audit=[] } = data;

TicketDetail.jsx: the reply POST does not clear the visibility state after send — if the admin sent an internal note the mode stays 'internal' for the next reply, which can accidentally leak internal-only text to the user on the next send. Consider resetting to 'user' after each successful reply.

Notifications.jsx submit(): audience_counts on the backend is a fixed map (see server.py line 587). For any audience not in the map, sent_count = 100. This is fine for demo but should be documented — main agent may want to compute this dynamically from the users collection.

ModulePage.jsx bulk loop (line 61-66): swallows individual errors silently (`catch { /* skip */ }`) — user only sees an aggregated success count. A per-id failure list would give better feedback; also there is no confirmation of failures in a toast if some items 403.
DataTable.jsx select-all only selects the CURRENT page (rows on screen). This is likely intended but not obvious; the bulk-bar just says 'N selected' without indicating page scope.
